name: interactive-ed
description: Interactive lessons for teaching: React frontend + FastAPI/SymPy backend.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && cd backend && uv sync
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8787
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend test && cd backend && uv run pytest
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && cd backend && uv run ruff check .
